## 758360aea29b

The production repair now matches the canonical rule's object semantics: objects are monochrome 4-connected components sorted by reading order, and the output compares their bounding-box widths. The sampler remains a controllable rectangle subset, but the validator accepts canonical irregular connected shapes, permits disconnected reuse of a color, rejects touching differently colored objects, reserves color 1, and enforces informative width variation. Palette and texture aliases now name real lawful palettes rather than degenerate examples.

The parametric family lives at `repo/generators/758360aea29b/workspace/parametric/`. Its default `pairwise_width` program is byte-exact canonical. sequential_dependency.intermediate: The selected marker coordinate/color and its NW–SE diagonal offset r-c.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Scan the nonzero source markers and select the highest-valued marker, breaking ties in row-major order.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Double the whole input and paint color 1 on background cells only along the selected marker’s doubled diagonal.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B consumes the marker/diagonal chosen by A. Skipping that selection and using all markers paints extra trails and changes the final grid.
